items.title: Pay utility statement balance
items.quote: Please settle the outstanding balance of €184.20 no later than 30 days after the date of this statement.
items.computation: The letter is dated 3 November 2025 (Monday). It is a private-law demand from a landlord, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the document date itself. Under §187(1) BGB the day of the event (3 Nov) is not counted, so counting starts 4 Nov. 30 days later (§188(1) BGB) falls on Wednesday, 3 December 2025. That day is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday (checked against NRW/nationwide holidays), so no shift under §193 BGB is needed. Final due date: 3 December 2025.

warnings: The IBAN given (DE56 3705 0198 0007 0707 07) is a formally valid German IBAN, but a valid IBAN does not prove ownership; confirm it matches earlier correspondence from Muster Apartments GmbH before paying.

The letter is addressed to Berlin (Warschauer Zeile 14, 10245 Berlin) while the landlord's business seat and the rented apartment (3.07) appear to be in Hamburg (Hafenstraße 12, 20459 Hamburg) — this is consistent with a tenant no longer living at the rented address, but worth a quick check that this is genuinely your utility statement if unexpected.
